description: This file implements event handling and management functions for an event loop in the lighttpd server, including socket closure, event loop initialization, run and cleanup routines, and the setup for various event types such as I/O, timers, signals, child process events, and various callbacks.

classes.name: closing_socket
classes.description: Represents a socket that is scheduled to be closed, including its associated event loop, file descriptor, socket link, and close timeout.

methods.name: void close_socket_now(closing_socket * cs)
methods.description: Closes the socket immediately, unlinks it from the event loop, and frees its memory.

methods.name: void closing_socket_cb(int revents,void * arg)
methods.description: Callback invoked when the socket can be read, handling EOF or errors, and closing the socket appropriately.

methods.name: void li_event_add_closing_socket(liEventLoop * loop,int fd)
methods.description: Adds a socket to the event loop's closing queue, initiates shutdown, and sets up the close timeout.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_init(liEventLoop * loop,struct ev_loop * evloop)
methods.description: Initializes an event loop, sets up queues, and job management.

methods.name: struct:ev_loop * li_event_loop_clear(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Cleans up the event loop, detaching all watchers and returning the underlying libev loop.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_run(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Runs the event loop until it is terminated.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_end(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Signals the event loop to end gracefully.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_exit(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Ends the event loop immediately, unlooping all events.

methods.name: void li_event_loop_force_close_sockets(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Forces closing of all sockets scheduled for closure in the loop.

methods.name: const char * li_event_loop_backend_string(liEventLoop * loop)
methods.description: Returns string representation of the underlying event backend used by libev.

methods.name: void li_event_io_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventIO * io,liEventCallback callback,int fd,int events)
methods.description: Initializes an I/O event watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_io_set_fd(liEventIO * io,int fd)
methods.description: Sets or updates the file descriptor associated with an I/O watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_io_set_events(liEventIO * io,int events)
methods.description: Updates the event mask for an I/O watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_io_add_events(liEventIO * io,int events)
methods.description: Adds specified events to an I/O watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_io_rem_events(liEventIO * io,int events)
methods.description: Removes specified events from an I/O watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_timer_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventTimer * timer,liEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Initializes a timer event watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_async_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventAsync * async,liEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Initializes an asynchronous event source.

methods.name: void li_event_child_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventChild * child,liEventCallback callback,int pid)
methods.description: Initializes a child process event watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_signal_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventSignal * sig,liEventCallback callback,int signum)
methods.description: Initializes a signal event watcher.

methods.name: void li_event_prepare_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventPrepare * prepare,liEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Initializes a prepare event watcher for pre-loop operations.

methods.name: void li_event_check_init(liEventLoop * loop,const char * event_name,liEventCheck * check,liEventCallback callback)
methods.description: Initializes a check event watcher for post-loop operations.

methods.name: const char * li_event_type_string(liEventType type)
methods.description: Provides a string description of the event type enum.
